notes:
Lead origin: self-serve signup from Product Hunt; founder (ex-mobile dev) built an MVP for collaborative notes with an AI assistant. Team: 2 founders + 1 contractor. Traffic: ~150 MAU, spike to 400 after launch. Primary objective: embed a lightweight chat assistant that can summarize threads, surface action items, and power quick note-generation templates. Key requirements: median chat latency < 300ms (first-token < 250ms desirable), very cost sensitive (target < $0.003 per 1k tokens), embeddings for similarity search (cheap/quantized models acceptable). Preference for hosted API with ability to pin model versions; want predictable token pricing and simple rate limits. No enterprise compliance required — API key auth + basic audit logs sufficient.
Recent timeline:
- 2026-02-28: self-serve signup and project created, uploaded sample notes
- 2026-03-01: automated onboarding email + quickstart; user ran Python SDK example
- 2026-03-03: telemetry shows 20 test chats, one 140-token spike
- 2026-03-04: founder replied asking detailed token pricing and rate-limit behavior (gmail thread).
Founder quote: "We need something reliable but cheap — embeddings at low cost would be a huge win."
Next actions: send two targeted emails (embeddings quickstart, token budgeting tips), monitor conversion and usage, nudges in-app for upgrade. No AE engagement planned unless they exceed $300/mo. Potential upsell: Dedicated if they later onboard enterprise customers or require data residency.
